patches.name: AB Lab
patches.description: Adds Afterglow's native experiment browser, typed overrides, profiles and recovery tools.

patches.name: AI Home
patches.description: Adds the Afterglow AI Home prompt library, favorites and history with YouTube feed navigation.

patches.name: AI channel filter
patches.description: Adds options to hide videos from channels flagged as AI-generated by the AiSList community list and to report AI channels from the video menu. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Add to queue
patches.description: Adds a video queue to the feed flyout menu, using either the Morphe queue or a native queue that uses YouTube's playlist interface. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Afterglow Control Center
patches.description: Adds the Afterglow hub with Vault, player state, quick controls, themes and recovery tools.

patches.name: Ambient mode
patches.description: Forces Ambient mode on and adds options to bypass power saving restrictions for Ambient mode and disable it entirely or in fullscreen. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: App refresh rate
patches.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Ask flyout menu
patches.description: Adds a video menu entry that opens Ask for the video and summarizes the video. This patch works with YouTube 21.16.256 and newer. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Autoplay
patches.description: Lets you start newly opened videos paused and optionally hide the native Autoplay switch.

patches.name: Background playback
patches.description: Lets videos, Shorts and videos made for kids keep playing in the background.

patches.name: Bypass link redirects
patches.description: Adds an option to bypass redirects and open the original link directly. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Caption options
patches.description: Adds options to disable captions from being automatically enabled, select a preferred caption language, add more auto-translate languages, and show captions in picture-in-picture. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Captions
patches.description: Remembers your caption choice and lets you prevent server and muted-device captions from turning on automatically.

patches.name: Change form factor
patches.description: Adds an option to change the UI appearance to a phone, tablet, or automotive device. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Channel search
patches.description: Adds an option to search inside the channel that is currently open instead of searching all of YouTube. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Channel whitelist
patches.description: Adds options to allow whitelisting specific channels to show ads or override playback speeds. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Comments header
patches.description: Lets you keep the native comment sort chips pinned while scrolling, hide them, or use YouTube's automatic behavior.

patches.name: Copy text
patches.description: Adds options to copy the video title and comments by tapping and holding them. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Copy video link
patches.description: Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Adds an option to show the app with the device system font or a custom TTF or OTF font file instead of YouTube Sans. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Custom player overlay opacity
patches.description: Adds an option to change the opacity of the video player background when player controls are visible. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: DeArrow
patches.description: Adds options to replace video thumbnails and titles using the DeArrow API, or replace video thumbnails with image captures from the video. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable DRC audio
patches.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable ambient mode
patches.description: Lets you disable the video's ambient lighting while preserving YouTube's own behavior when off.

patches.name: Disable auto feed refresh
patches.description: Adds an option to stop feeds from refreshing automatically after they become outdated. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable fullscreen gestures
patches.description: Adds options to selectively disable gestures for entering and exiting fullscreen mode, and to disable pinch-to-zoom. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable haptic feedback
patches.description: Adds an option to disable haptic feedback in the player for various actions. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable layout updates
patches.description: Adds an option to disable server side layout updates and use an older UI. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable player popup panels
patches.description: Adds an option to disable panels (such as live chat) from opening automatically. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable playlist autoplay
patches.description: Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable rolling number animations
patches.description: Adds an option to disable rolling number animations of video view count, user likes, and upload time. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable scrolling speed limit
patches.description: Adds an option to remove limits of how fast the home and subscription feed can be scrolled. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable sign in to TV popup
patches.description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Disable video codecs
patches.description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 or AV1 codecs. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Double tap to seek
patches.description: Adds additional double-tap to seek values to the YouTube settings menu. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Download post images
patches.description: Adds a button and a menu item to download the images and GIFs of posts. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Downloads and Vault
patches.description: Adds the Afterglow download sheets, resumable queue and Vault for videos, audio, captions and thumbnails. Configure in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Enable debugging
patches.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Feed card layout
patches.description: Adds an option to show or hide the card layout of feed videos, which YouTube sends as an A/B test. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Feed menus
patches.description: Lets you remove rows such as Play next, Not interested and Report from video menus.

patches.name: Feed video actions
patches.description: Adds a Watch later button to video thumbnails in feeds, and opens the video menu by tapping and holding anywhere on a video. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Feed view count
patches.description: Adds the view count to the bottom left of the thumbnails of feed videos. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Fix album covers
patches.description: Loads album and profile images from an alternate YouTube image server when enabled in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Force animations
patches.description: Adds an option to always turn on or off the app animations that YouTube can turn off, such as the player transitions. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Force fullscreen landscape
patches.description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Force original audio
patches.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Fullscreen
patches.description: Controls automatic fullscreen, exit on finish, and fullscreen playback in portrait orientation.

patches.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Glow
patches.description: Adds Glow Lab and theme-colored light around tab icons, player controls, and the scrubber.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Runs Afterglow alongside the original YouTube app and supports signing in through compatible GmsCore.

patches.name: Hide Shorts components
patches.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

options.title: Hide Shorts app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Shorts when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

options.title: Hide Shorts widget
options.description: Permanently hides the launcher widget Shorts button.

patches.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide info cards
patches.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide layout components
patches.description: Adds options to hide general layout components. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide related video overlay
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide status bar
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide timestamp
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Hide video action buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Interface layout
patches.description: Adds left-to-right paragraph formatting and a supported older Android interface through Morphe's version compatibility settings.

patches.name: Lite Mode
patches.description: Adds Afterglow's simplified Home, Subscriptions, You and Afterglow tabs with reduced distractions, while preserving your saved preferences.

patches.name: Long-press tools
patches.description: Adds Description-header copying, comment and post actions, profile photo saving and copying, and timestamped links when you tap Pause, as selected in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Loop video
patches.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Media notification controls
patches.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Mini player
patches.description: Enables playback for restricted videos in the mini player and restores the original playlist minibar.

patches.name: Miniplayer
patches.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.208 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Native share sheet
patches.description: Opens Android's share sheet for YouTube links when enabled in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Lets you hide the Cast, Notifications, Search and voice search buttons and the filter chips, hide or swap the YouTube logo, and keep the top bar pinned.

patches.name: Navigation options
patches.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

options.title: Hide Search app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Search when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

options.title: Hide Subscriptions app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Subscriptions when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Niconico comments
patches.description: Adds an option to show live chat and chat replay as comments that scroll across the video. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Overlay buttons
patches.description: Adds Afterglow's player controls sheet, download entry, mute, lock, settings and shared eye modes for player overlays.

patches.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Play all
patches.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Playback buffer
patches.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Playback end time
patches.description: Adds the expected playback finish time to the native player bar, accounting for playback speed.

patches.name: Playback in feeds
patches.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Afterglow settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Lets you set the hold-to-speed rate and a default playback rate, up to 5x.

patches.name: Playback speed options
patches.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Player buttons and menus
patches.description: Lets you hide the Download, Share, Save, Remix and Clip buttons under the video, and the Download and Share menu rows.

patches.name: Player gestures
patches.description: Controls tap-to-seek, chapter snapping, independent double-tap gestures, and free zoom while keeping pinch-to-fill.

patches.name: Player icon style
patches.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

options.title: Custom icons
options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'morphe_yt_copy.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

patches.name: Player overlay
patches.description: Lets you hide native controls, replace transport paddles with rewind and fast forward on standalone videos, and pause playback while the controls appear.

patches.name: PoToken provider
patches.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Privacy
patches.description: Lets you open links without Google and YouTube redirects, drop the share id from shared links and hide search suggestions.

patches.name: Reload video
patches.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Remember loop mode
patches.description: Remembers your native loop choice and restores it when a video opens.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes video ads and the ads and paid promotion labels in feeds and on the watch page.

patches.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Restore original titles
patches.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike, and the like count and like ratio on the thumbnails of feed videos. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Save to Watch later
patches.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player, and adds a setting to redirect Watch later saves to a playlist of your choice. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Search comments
patches.description: Adds a button to the comments to show only the loaded comments that contain the searched words. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Seek bar
patches.description: Customizes native player tracks and scrubbers, and controls persistent progress and the most-replayed graph.

patches.name: Seekbar
patches.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Series tracking
patches.description: Adds a series library to History with local progress and episode continuation. This patch works with YouTube 21.02 and newer. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Settings menu filter
patches.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Shorts
patches.description: Lets you hide Shorts shelves and cards in Home, Subscriptions, search and related videos.

patches.name: Shorts autoplay
patches.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Shorts icon style
patches.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

options.title: Custom icons
options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'morphe_shorts_heart.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

patches.name: Shorts layout and buttons
patches.description: Hides the Shorts player buttons and overlay parts you turn off in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Skip content warning
patches.description: Lets you skip YouTube's viewer discretion dialog on sensitive videos.

patches.name: Skip live Shorts
patches.description: Automatically skips live streams that appear in the Shorts feed. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Skip silence
patches.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: SponsorBlock
patches.description: Skips selected SponsorBlock categories with undo and colored timeline markers, including Shorts.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Spoof video streams
patches.description: Uses compatible YouTube player clients to keep video playback working in the patched app.

patches.name: Startup tab and animation
patches.description: Opens YouTube on the startup tab you pick in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Swipe controls
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Tab bar
patches.description: Customizes native tabs, the bonus row, centered anchors, labels, indicators and tab bar appearance in Afterglow settings.

patches.name: Theme Studio
patches.description: Adds Afterglow's 30 presets, custom theme editor and library, portable theme files, and native YouTube colors and gradients on Android 14+. Restart to apply.

patches.name: Translate posts
patches.description: Adds a menu item to translate the text of posts. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Typography
patches.description: Customizes app and tab text size, weight and style, with Afterglow's bundled fonts and Android system families.

patches.name: Video delay
patches.description: Adds an option to delay the video, to keep it in sync with laggy Bluetooth audio. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Video quality
patches.description: Sets default Wi-Fi and mobile-data quality and restores the classic resolution menu.

patches.name: Video quality options
patches.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Voice over translation
patches.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.

patches.name: Watch page
patches.description: Lets you hide below-player recommendations while keeping video information and comments, the Continue watching card, the "Are you still watching?" pause, end-screen cards and end-screen related videos.

patches.name: Wide search bar
patches.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed. Configure in Afterglow settings → Additional features.
